page.layout: One printed page of running text, single column, with a running head at the top, a page number at the top left, and a fleuron below the closing word FINIS. No marginal notes. Faint show-through of text from the reverse side is ignored.

main_text.p: assa in vino infusa in sorbitiones dissoluere expediet. Sic enim efficacius retentricem facultatem roborabunt. Succus perdicis satis assa omnia quae exegimus habet, eo tamen vti cum pane aegrotanti commodius erit. Phasianus simpliciter optima caro est, & magis nutrit quam perdix, minus tamen imbecilles particulas roborat. Caro enim phasiani media est inter perdicem & pullam gallinaceam. Quae nam victus forma et qualitas iis qui liquefacientibus detinentur febribus conueniat, supra dictum est.

page.notes: The running head and the first line are set in a mixture of roman and italic type; the text is mostly italic. Some words are blurred by the scan, notably "assa" at the line start and "simpliciter" which I could not clearly read and have not used. Possible misprints left as printed: "Phasianus" and "pullam". The fleuron is an ornament, not transcribed.
